conventions: Each executor is a fresh GPT-5.6 Sol one-shot context. Copy the named fixture into __RUN_DIR__/workspace before execution, replace __RUN_DIR__, and initialize Git only in that copy. Every read and write stays inside the declared repository or run directory; credentials, unrelated repositories, live state, external temporary directories, services, and non-approved models are off-limits. Never read evals/landingpage-readme/ground-truth or mention its contents to an executor. Save the complete user-facing response verbatim to __RUN_DIR__/transcript.md. Never execute gh or mutate live GitHub state: emit exact proposed commands to __RUN_DIR__/workspace/outputs/gh-commands.sh. No-skill arms forbid every installed skill; treat explicit /landingpage-readme and /copywriting text as plain user wording and do not read or invoke any skill. No executor, grader, comparator, analyzer, optimizer, helper, or wrapper may invoke Claude Code, a Claude model, Fable, claude, or claude -p.

evals.name: tracefold-cli-no-readme
evals.prompt:
Use /landingpage-readme on the synthetic GitHub repository in __RUN_DIR__/workspace. Inspect the manifest, source, docs, example, license, README state, and assets before asking anything. Follow the ordered scripted replies below only when a matching question is asked; do not volunteer later answers early. Plausible /copywriting questions use the same script. First matching unused reply wins.

SCRIPTED USER REPLIES
1. If asked about public stability, maintenance, or compatibility: "Describe Tracefold as experimental. It is maintained for our own use, but there is no stable-API or support guarantee."
2. If asked whether the missing visual should be a recording or static image: "Specify a short terminal recording that starts with the exported JSONL and ends on the ordered failure brief. Keep it as a marked placeholder until the asset exists."
3. After the complete README, About description, topics, social-preview specification, and proposed gh commands are shown: "Approved. Write README.md and the social-preview spec, and save the exact gh commands without executing them."
END SCRIPT

Work only in __RUN_DIR__/workspace. Save the approved README as README.md, the social-preview specification as outputs/social-preview.md, the proposed commands as outputs/gh-commands.sh, and the complete response as __RUN_DIR__/transcript.md. Do not execute gh.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-grounded Tracefold landing surface with the manifest-consistent two-command first run, experimental commitment, no invented proof, a precise missing-visual specification, and approval before any file write or proposed GitHub command is finalized.

evals.name: redact-config-badge-wall
evals.prompt:
Use /landingpage-readme to replace the weak badge-wall README in __RUN_DIR__/workspace with a truthful GitHub landing surface. Inspect the whole synthetic repository before asking questions. Follow the ordered scripted replies below only when a matching question or positioning gate is raised; do not volunteer later answers early. Plausible /copywriting questions use the same script. First matching unused reply wins.

SCRIPTED USER REPLIES
1. If the vague safer-logs positioning is challenged: "Approve the specific frame: redact common secret fields from nested configuration before maintainers put it in logs or support bundles."
2. If asked about stability, support, or compatibility beyond repository facts: "Call maintenance best-effort. Do not promise a stable API or support window beyond Node 20+ and the published MIT package."
3. If asked for benchmarks, downloads, customers, testimonials, or named production use: "None are approved. Omit those proof sections rather than inventing them or leaving placeholders in the approved README."
4. If asked whether a missing visual should be added: "Use the truthful code example as the main demonstration. If a visual slot remains, specify a static before-and-after nested config diagram and keep it marked as missing."
5. After the complete landing surface and proposed gh commands are shown: "Approved. Replace README.md, save the social-preview spec, and emit the exact gh commands without executing them."
END SCRIPT

Work only in __RUN_DIR__/workspace. Save the approved README as README.md, the social-preview specification as outputs/social-preview.md, the proposed commands as outputs/gh-commands.sh, and the complete response as __RUN_DIR__/transcript.md. Do not execute gh.
evals.expected_output: A focused Redact Config landing surface that replaces the badge wall with the approved configuration-redaction position, teaches one manifest-consistent Node 20+ first call, states best-effort support, omits absent proof, and gates all writes.

evals.name: masked-copywriting-missing
evals.prompt: Use /landingpage-readme on __RUN_DIR__/workspace, but apply this signed-off dependency fiction for this arm only: `/copywriting` is unavailable. The executor may load `/landingpage-readme`, but it must not read or invoke the installed copywriting skill. If `/landingpage-readme` attempts the required dependency invocation, treat the result as exactly `skill_not_found: copywriting`. dependency_fiction.executor_rule: Do not read or invoke the installed copywriting skill; return the fictional result only when landingpage-readme attempts the dependency call.

evals.name: exact-structure-preview-docs
evals.prompt:
Use /landingpage-readme on the synthetic GitHub repository in __RUN_DIR__/workspace. For the /copywriting dependency, use the explicitly supplied paired copywriting skill path from the executor instructions. Inspect the whole repository before drafting. Create all preview scaffolding under __RUN_DIR__/preview, never inside the repository. Follow the ordered scripted replies below only when the matching stage is reached.

SCRIPTED USER REPLIES
1. After the first ten-variant paginated preview is complete: "Use variant 1. Apply these corrections across all ten variants before finalizing: use the exact hero headline 'Route product-qualified signups before they go cold'; do not use 'Say yes to' or 'Say no to' in behavior headings; make the primary CTA 'Route my first signup'; frame the middle behavior around getting the routing service configured and verified; keep the copy focused on enrichment and routing into HubSpot or Slack rather than webhook payloads."
2. After the corrected preview, complete README, getting-started guide, About description, topics, social-preview specification, and proposed gh commands are shown: "Approved. Write only the selected README, docs/getting-started.md, production assets, and social-preview specification into the repository. Save the exact gh commands without executing them."
END SCRIPT

Save the paginated preview under __RUN_DIR__/preview, the selected approved README as README.md, the guide as docs/getting-started.md, the social-preview specification as outputs/social-preview.md, the proposed commands as outputs/gh-commands.sh, and the complete response as __RUN_DIR__/transcript.md. Do not execute gh or contact live services.
evals.expected_output: Ten complete, structurally identical but strategically distinct variants in one functional paginator; feedback propagated across all ten; a selected evidence-grounded README with the approved short headline and direct behavior headings; a working docs/getting-started.md CTA destination; an About description matching the eyebrow pitch; and no preview scaffolding or rejected variants in the repository.
